observable_features: A planted open court is held between a high brick screen wall and a lower building edge.
Small repeated openings perforate the enclosing wall while a recessed doorway leads beyond the court.
The low eave, timber-framed glazing and narrow planted ground strip define an intermediate inside/outside edge.
